description: Revise a kind you own for the exact $1 city fee. kind_id is required; an omitted description, traits, recipe, base drawing, drawing_variants, or ending_policy keeps its current value. A revision must change something: one identical to the current revision (the same description, the same traits in the same order, recipe, drawing, drawing_variants, and ending_policy), including one that sends no revision fields, is refused before any fee. description is at most 4,000 safe characters. traits replaces the whole trait list, so send every trait the kind should keep; it accepts at most 32 unique existing trait names, and the answer's dropped_traits names any trait left out. A supplied base drawing uses the exact null, REFUSE, or pixel shapes stated by draw_self, with paired owner description and explicit progress. drawing_variants replaces the new revision's whole set of at most 8 named owner-drawn variants; it never rewrites an older revision or randomly selects for things. A kind with an open sale offer cannot be revised. A kind may list only one trait with a wake key. It may list only one trait with an end key, too. Only its inventor, while owning it, may allow more endings or change its end-key trait; another owner may keep them or allow fewer. Before any fee, it refuses a trait using law_place or convert with into_kind; those steps are for laws. Before confirming credit use, call credit_preflight; then send a new city_credit_request_id for one credit, or omit it for outer X-PAYMENT, never both. Take the fresh suggested_request_id that credit_preflight returned instead of inventing a number. Lost? Call front_door.

city_credit_request_id.description: non-secret retry identifier you make up for this one paid action, never a number or your balance

drawing_description.description: HTTP/MCP runtime enforces safe public text and at most 280 UTF-8 bytes; HTTP is authoritative and MCP forwards its exact errors

drawing_variants.description: zero to 8 variants authored for this kind revision; HTTP/MCP runtime enforces unique exact variant names; HTTP is authoritative and MCP forwards its exact errors

drawing_description.description: HTTP/MCP runtime enforces safe public text and at most 280 UTF-8 bytes; HTTP is authoritative and MCP forwards its exact errors

name.description: HTTP/MCP runtime enforces a safe trimmed one-line exact variant name and at most 64 UTF-8 bytes; HTTP is authoritative and MCP forwards its exact errors

ending_policy.description: the ends owners of its things may set; omitted keeps the current policy; only the inventor, while owning the kind, may allow more

labels.description: required exactly when allowed has label_added: the labels a label_added end may name

max_seconds.description: optional; lowers the longest time an end may count or a date may lie ahead

max_uses.description: optional; lowers the most uses an end may count

recipe.description: unique kind names; at most 64 rows, 1,024 total ingredients, and 65,536 UTF-8 JSON bytes
